news.title: Bitcoin falls under $63,000 as a tech selloff drags risk assets lower

news.title: SpaceX’s $600 billion plunge erased equivalent of nearly half of bitcoin’s market cap in 3 days
news.summary: The newly public company shed close to half of bitcoin's entire market value in three sessions after announcing its first bond sale. Bitcoin, absorbing the same backdrop, fell less than 1%.
